ios.desc:
Text With Jesus is an AI Bible chat app for Christians who want prayer, guidance, and study support in one place.

Chat with Jesus, the Holy Family, apostles, prophets, and other biblical figures in a simple conversational experience. Receive personalized voice messages through Voicemails, and over time the figures you chat with can learn facts about you to make each conversation more engaging and personal.

Key Features:
- Chat with Jesus, the Holy Family, apostles, and more using advanced AI technology *
- Ask to receive personalized voice messages
- Explore the wisdom of the Old Testament through conversations with its prophets and heroes
- Engage in meaningful dialogue and receive guidance tailored to your spiritual needs
- Use devotion tools designed to support daily prayer and Bible study
- Talk with spiritual advisors tailored to your specific faith tradition
- Tailored to your preferred faith tradition
- Suitable for all ages - share and grow in faith as a family

* A Premium subscription is required for unlimited messages and access to the full range of figures.
** A limited number of trial credits is available for free users. Subscribe or purchase credit packs for more.

Whether you need encouragement in difficult moments or want to deepen your understanding of Scripture, Text With Jesus gives you a direct way to explore faith through conversation.
